Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "we need to settle the watering rota for the north greenhouse before the new seedlings arrive on friday uh the small beds dry out faster than the benches so they need checking every morning i had written tuesday for elena no sorry wednesday because she is covering the late delivery on tuesday mara asked if thursday was still hers and i said right that means she can take the whole house after lunch as usual for the three things to check first look at the moisture trays then the hanging baskets and finally the two citrus tubs near the door if the forecast stays warm please add a second pass on saturday but only for the seedling benches otherwise one pass is enough daniel can handle sunday and leave the hose on the lower hook not across the path last week it caught on the cart and pulled the timer loose so we should test the timer after the rota is posted i might have missed one of the west tables in my notes and i will check that when i walk through this afternoon the paper copy should go beside the tool cabinet not on the potting table where it gets wet", "output": "We need to settle the watering rota for the north greenhouse before the new seedlings arrive on Friday. The small beds dry out faster than the benches, so they need checking every morning. I had written Tuesday for Elena—no, sorry, Wednesday, because she is covering the late delivery on Tuesday. Mara asked if Thursday was still hers, and I said, “Right, that means she can take the whole house after lunch as usual.”\n\nThe three things to check: first, look at the moisture trays, then the hanging baskets, and finally the two citrus tubs near the door. If the forecast stays warm, please add a second pass on Saturday, but only for the seedling benches. Otherwise, one pass is enough. Daniel can handle Sunday and leave the hose on the lower hook, not across the path. Last week it caught on the cart and pulled the timer loose, so we should test the timer after the rota is posted. I might have missed one of the west tables in my notes, and I will check that when I walk through this afternoon. The paper copy should go beside the tool cabinet, not on the potting table where it gets wet."}]
